Name: Sprout Dig Spots
Author: MissMcCloud
Description:
This mod replaces the artifact and seed dig spots with cute animated sprouts, making them easier to spot. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JAybKJf.gif[/img]

[size=5]How to install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Install the latest version of Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿. [i](Not required for the mod to work but very useful to have for configuring settings!)[/i]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
Once you've installed this mod, the sprouts should automatically replace the artifact dig spot worms as well as the seed dig spots. You can till them with a hoe and uncover items just as you would with the regular dig spots.

[size=5]Seasonal Variants + Settings[/size]
In the latest version of this mod, the sprouts will change color depending on the season to make them better blend in with their surroundings by default.

If you'd like to switch back to the default sprout color from previous versions that stays the same year-round, you can use the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ mod to adjust those settings. You can also use this menu to disable/re-enable the sprouts replacing the artifact and/or seed spots without uninstalling the mod or exiting the game.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/Mac/Windows. Older versions of this mod can be used for previous versions of the game.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer. (Other players in your multiplayer group won't be able to see the dig spots as sprouts unless they have installed this mod as well.)
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Added the option to toggle between seasonal and default sprout colors in the mod config menu, tooltip descriptions when hovering over the options, and support for translations. Works best with game versions before 1.6!
